ASB_Case_Definition: Positive urine culture with bacterial growth without documented signs or symptoms of UTI in adult inpatients (>=18y); >=10^5 CFU/mL referenced in background (p. 1-2)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Death within 48h of admission, urologic procedures with mucosal involvement, neutropenia (ANC <1,000/mL), receiving antibiotics for concomitant active infections (p. 1-2)
Comparator_Type: Multi-Period Cohort (Pre-BPA vs BPA vs BPAN)
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: 3-group P<.01; Pre vs BPA P<.01; Pre vs BPAN P=.04; BPA vs BPAN P=.06; Multivariable OR (adj site & LOS, Table 4): BPA aOR 0.43 (95% CI 0.28-0.67, P<.01); BPAN aOR 0.78 (95% CI 0.56-1.08, P=.13)
DOT_Pre_vs_Post_Days: Median ceftriaxone 3d across all 3 cohorts (FQ & nitrofurantoin similar; exact median NR, p. 3)

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive urine culture without documented UTI-specific symptoms (dysuria, frequency, urgency, suprapubic pain, hematuria; absence of EHR doc treated as absent) (p. 3, 6)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Pregnancy, urinary catheterization, neutropenia, renal transplant, pre-urologic procedure, immunosuppression (CD4 <200) (Fig. 1, p. 3)

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive UC without documented UTI symptoms (dysuria, suprapubic/flank pain, CVA tenderness, septic shock, AMS >=65y), pregnancy, urologic proc, immunosuppression, or critical illness (p. 2)
Excluded_Special_Pops: None (pregnant ~34%, urologic proc 1-7%, immunosuppressed 2-6.5%, ICU 1-3% INCLUDED as appropriate indications; excluded <18y, prior abx, candiduria, missing data)

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive UC >=10^5 CFU/mL without UTI signs/symptoms (dysuria, flank/suprapubic pain, CVA tenderness, septic shock, AMS >=65y), regardless of pyuria; excluding pregnancy, urologic proc, immunocompromised, critically ill (p. 2-3)
Excluded_Special_Pops: None (pregnant 30.4%, urologic proc 6.2%, immunosuppressed 3.8%, ICU 4.5% INCLUDED; excluded <18y, prior abx, candiduria, incomplete data)

ASB_Case_Definition: Asymptomatic pyuria subgroup: UA >=10 WBC/hpf without documented dysuria, suprapubic pain, or flank pain (~46-47% of UCs grew no pathogen/mixed flora; also Table 2 any abx without UTI sx) (p. 1, 5, 7)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Pregnant patients, <18y, patient-directed discharge before complete workup, point-of-care UA; transplant recipients included (p. 2, Fig. 3 p. 6)
Pre_Reported_Pct: 83.7% (72/86 asymp pyuria; Table 2 all abx w/o UTI sx: 297/942 [31.95%])
Post_Reported_Pct: 67.3% (70/104 asymp pyuria; Table 2 all abx w/o UTI sx: 316/1089 [29.02%])
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: Asymp w/ pyuria any abx: 72/86 (83.7%) -> 70/104 (67.3%), P=NR [mixed/no-growth UCs 45.7% pre vs 47.2% post]; Total ED abx (incl ~62% non-UTI): 384/943 (40.72%; text 40.76%) -> 415/1089 (38.11%), P=.24

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive reflex UC >50,000 CFU/mL without documented UTI symptoms in adult inpatient/rehab admissions (Table 3: 58/100 Pre vs 34/68 Post had ASB) (p. 2-3)
Excluded_Special_Pops: ED discharges excluded; pregnant, indwelling catheters, SCI, neurogenic bladder, urologic hardware/anatomy/proc <90d, immunosuppression, UTI tx <90d (p. 2)
Pre_Reported_Pct: 70.7% among confirmed ASB (41/58; Table 3 reports 41/100 [41%] of all pos-UC subgroup)
Post_Reported_Pct: 70.6% among confirmed ASB (24/34; Table 3 reports 24/68 [35%] of all pos-UC subgroup)
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: Confirmed ASB tx virtually unchanged: 41/58 (70.7%) -> 24/34 (70.6%); Table 3 whole-subgroup ASB tx: 41/100 (41%) -> 24/68 (35%), P=0.46 (ASB prevalence 58% -> 50%, P=0.57)
DOT_Pre_vs_Post_Days: Subgroup abx utilization: 533 -> 442 antibiotic days/1,000 PD, P=0.052 (Table 3)

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive UC growing <100,000 CFU/mL bacteria without documented UTI symptoms (dysuria, frequency/urgency, CVA tenderness) or systemic signs (fever, hemodynamic instability) (p. 2, 5)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Pregnancy (n=69), planned urologic procedure (n=14), antibiotics for other infection (n=324), mixed flora/yeast (n=16), repeat/duplicate UC (n=106), non-inpatient (n=74) (Fig. 1, p. 3)
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: >72h continuation P=.016; Logistic reg for DISCONTINUATION by 72h: OR 2.7 (1.3-5.3), aOR 2.5 (1.3-4.9), P=.006 (adj >1 org, CCI<4, pyuria); Init P=.17; >48h P=.036; DC P=.028
DOT_Pre_vs_Post_Days: Median 4 (IQR 0-7 in T3; 1-6 in Abstract) -> 1 (IQR 0-6), P=.022

ASB_Case_Definition: ED UTI diagnosis + discharge abx + abnormal UA (pos LE, nitrites, >=5 WBC/hpf, or bacteria) WITHOUT focal cystitis sx, fever >38C, rigors, or sepsis (non-localizing sx w/ clear non-UTI cause counted as ASB) (p. 2)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Pregnancy, neurogenic bladder, non-UTI abx (incl prostatitis/orchitis/epididymitis), already on abx, pyelonephritis, and 'unknown' symptoms (n=159 post omitted) (p. 2, Fig. 1 p. 3)
Pre_Reported_Pct: 28% of UTI-tx ED visits (286/1,005 across 16 EDs, 2017)
Post_Reported_Pct: 29% of UTI-tx ED visits (199/697 across 23 EDs; Table 3 sums all 23 EDs = 697)
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: ASB % among abx-treated ED UTI visits: OR 1.00 (95% CI 0.81-1.24), P=.97 (range 11%-53% across 23 EDs; 0%-71% across 38 providers; Hospital 1 improved 34%->13%, P=.03). Primary cystitis: >7d duration 29% (129/446) -> 12% (39/339), OR 0.32 (0.22-0.47), P<.01; FQ 32% (144/446) -> 7% (25/339), OR 0.17 (0.11-0.26), P<.01
DOT_Pre_vs_Post_Days: NR (178 unnecessary cystitis days avoided from reduced >7d Rx)

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive UC in adults >=18y without localized GU symptoms (frequency, urgency, dysuria, CVA tenderness, hematuria, suprapubic pain); IDSA compliance rubric allowed abx for pregnancy, urologic proc, renal transplant <1mo, fever/AMS+SIRS (p. 2-3, Table 1)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Symptomatic UTI cases excluded (120/174 [68.9%]); pregnancy, pre-urologic proc, <1mo renal transplant kept as allowable treatment indications (Table 1b)
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: Binomial test vs 50% baseline: overall 66.7% (36/54), P=.01 (target >=80% not met); Ph I vs II vs III chi-sq P=.80 (no comparative OR/RR)
DOT_Pre_vs_Post_Days: NR (median/mean DOT not reported; 5d cephalexin noted for most common Rx)

ASB_Case_Definition: Positive UC/UA without documented UTI symptoms (frequency, urgency, dysuria, fever, suprapubic pain, or AMS in non-verbalizing pts); Table 2 denominator is all included UAs (p. 78)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Admitted ED patients, concurrent non-UTI abx, duplicate UCs, chronic bladder management devices (applied to 2015 pre & 2017-18 post primary objective; n=150 post excluded) (p. 77-78, Fig. 1)
Pre_Reported_Pct: 10.2% of included UAs (16/157; also neg-UA abx 6/109 [5.5%])
Post_Reported_Pct: 1.9% of included UAs (2/105; also neg-UA abx 3/70 [4.3%])
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: Inappropriate abx for ASB (per all included UAs): 16/157 (10.2%) -> 2/105 (1.9%), OR 0.17 (CI NR), P=.01 (Table 2); Neg-UA abx: 6/109 (5.5%) -> 3/70 (4.3%), P=.74 (Table 3; Abstract states -25.3% unexplained)

ASB_Case_Definition: Adult inpatients >18y with positive UC (>10^5 CFU/mL) and NO documented UTI symptoms (fever, dysuria, frequency, urgency, hematuria, flank pain, N/V, CVA tenderness) at UC time; AMS counted as ASB (p. 2-3, 5)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Pregnancy, urologic procedure, kidney transplant <1 mo, indwelling urinary catheter (p. 2, Fig. 1 p. 3)

ASB_Case_Definition: >100,000 CFU/mL single organism without fever, leukocytosis, suprapubic pain, frequency, or shock (mixed >100K excluded; >30d pre-CABG window)
Excluded_Special_Pops: Mixed organisms excluded; asymptomatic urologic procedures not applicable (CABG/CBGB surgical cohort)
Reported_Effect_Adj_OR_RR_95CI: Among detected >100K ASB: 6/9 (66.7%) vs 3/4 (75.0%); Cohort-level ASB Rx halved (6 -> 3, -50%; all bacteriuria Rx 9/254 -> 4/248, P=.11 NS, unpowered)
